chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Awrama and ‘Alī ibn ‘Abd Allah, from ‘Alī ibn Hassan, from ‘Abd al-Rahmān ibn Kathīr, from Abū ‘Abd Allāh عليه السلام, regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Surely those who believed, then disbelieved, then believed, then disbelieved, then increased in disbelief—their repentance shall not be accepted.

He said: It was revealed concerning so-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so. They believed in the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in the beginning of the affair, then they disbelieved when the wilayah was presented to them, at the time when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said: Whomever I am his mawla, then this ‘Alī is his mawla.

Then they believed through the pledge of allegiance to Amīr al-Mu’minīn عليه السلام, then they disbelieved when the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله passed away, so they did not affirm the pledge of allegiance. Then they increased in disbelief by taking those who had pledged allegiance to him and making the pledge of allegiance for themselves. So these are ones in whom nothing of faith remained.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام as Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith, here meaning true inward belief that ultimately did not remain
key_terms.الْبَيْعَةِ: the pledge of allegiance or formal acknowledgement of authority
key_terms.الْوِلَايَةُ: the divinely ordained authority and guardianship presented to them
key_terms.كَفَرُوا: they disbelieved or rejected after prior belief
key_terms.مَوْلَاهُ: his master, patron, or authority-holder in the statement of Ghadir

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 4:137 interpreted in Shia hadith in relation to the wilayah of Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report presents the verse as referring to people who repeatedly moved between outward affirmation and rejection, culminating in a complete loss of faith. In this narration, the turning point is their refusal of the wilayah of Amīr al-Mu’minīn ‘Alī عليه السلام and their reversal after the passing of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
